content: Add an implicitly routed converge-project-changes workflow skill that inventories an explicit collaborator-delivered change set, enforces project-level conformance without inferring ownership, directly repairs only integration-owned compatible gaps, and routes foreign-session or breaking semantic work to the existing guidance and semantic-governance owners. This additive repository workflow uses M0110 only as its 0.1.1.0 delivery coordinate and does not activate M0110 or W0111 product implementation.

Content revision faea90189f2b34fb53667e20f843b9bd737c87c6 added the implicitly routed convergence workflow, exact ownership/disposition protocol, and read-only four-layer Git inventory. Independent forward and implementation audits found and drove correction of session/layer ABA races, opaque untracked directories, no-follow file reads, replacement-ref contamination, fsmonitor execution, and closing-drift classification; their final reviews reported no remaining findings. Inventory self-tests passed 15/15, routing passed 89 cases plus 34/34 self-tests, Agent records and package validation passed, and the final dev CTest passed 65/65.
